title: Tenants
description: Tenants are the customers or organizations inside this product. Their data is strictly separated.

create.title: Create tenant
create.description: You can invite members after creating the tenant.
create.slugHelp: URL-friendly identifier, derived from the name. Must be unique within the product.
create.slugInfo: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2–63 characters), starting with a letter or digit. The slug cannot be changed later and is typed to confirm deletion.

empty.title: No tenants yet
empty.body: Create a tenant for each customer or organization that uses this product.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different search or status filter.

detail.deleteBody: “{{name}}” is deleted together with its records, files, memberships, invitations and tenant-bound API keys. This cannot be undone.
detail.suspendBody: Members of “{{name}}” and its API keys lose access until the tenant is reactivated. Product operators can still open the tenant and reactivate it, but not its data; only platform administrators can. No data is deleted.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Invite people by email to join a tenant.
invitations.pickTenant: Choose a tenant to see its invitations
invitations.inviteDescription: The invitation is valid for 7 days. If notifications are enabled, Axentra also emails the link.
invitations.oneTimeBody: Share this only with the invited person. It cannot be displayed again; if it is lost, revoke the invitation and create a new one.
invitations.revokeBody: The invitation for {{email}} will stop working.
invitations.tokenHelp: No invitation link was generated because notifications are not enabled on this server, so share the token. The person signs in and enters it under “Accept invitation”.
invitations.roleHelp: The person gets this role in the tenant after accepting.
invitations.emailInfo: Only a signed-in user whose account has exactly this email address can accept the invitation.
invitations.expiresInfo: Invitations are valid for 7 days. To extend one, revoke it and invite again.

accept.title: Accept invitation
accept.description: Join a tenant with the invitation link or token you received. Sign in with the account for the email address the invitation was sent to, check the details and confirm.
accept.tokenHelp: Paste the token from the invitation if you did not open the link.
accept.tokenFromLink: Filled in from your invitation link. It is no longer shown in the address bar.
accept.successBody: You are now a member with the role {{role}}. It may take a moment until the access appears everywhere.
accept.successBodyNamed: You are now a member of {{tenant}} in {{product}} with the role {{role}}.
accept.switchAccountAction: Sign out and use the invited address
accept.noEmailTitle: Your account has no email address
accept.noEmail: Invitations are bound to an email address, so an account without one cannot accept them. Sign in with the account for the invited address, or ask the person who invited you to add your account to the tenant directly.

invalid.title: This invitation cannot be used
invalid.body: The server does not say which of these applies:
invalid.expired: it has expired (invitations are valid for 7 days),
invalid.used: it was already accepted, by you or in another tab,
invalid.mistyped: the link or token is incomplete or mistyped.
invalid.next: Ask the person who invited you for a new invitation.

wrongEmail.title: Invitation for another email address
wrongEmail.body: The invitation was sent to a different address than the one of the account you are signed in with ({{account}}). Sign out and sign in with the invited address, or ask for an invitation to your own address.

noEmail.title: Your account has no email address

inactive.title: The tenant is not active
inactive.body: The tenant (or its product) you were invited to is suspended or closed, so nobody can join it right now. Your invitation was not used. Ask the person who invited you to reactivate the tenant, then try again.

inviterLost.title: The invitation is no longer valid
inviterLost.body: The person who invited you can no longer give you this role, for example because their own role or membership changed. Ask them or another administrator of the tenant for a new invitation.

unreachable.title: The server could not be reached
unreachable.body: Your invitation was not changed. Check your connection and try again in a moment.

reactivate.title: Reactivate tenant?
reactivate.body: Members of “{{name}}” and its API keys regain access immediately, with the same roles and permissions as before. Its data becomes available again.

suspendedBanner.title: This tenant is suspended
suspendedBanner.body: Its members and API keys are locked out, and its members, invitations, records, files, usage and billing cannot be opened. No data has been deleted.
suspendedBanner.bodyPlatform: Its members, product operators and API keys cannot access its data; your platform role still can. No data has been deleted.
suspendedBanner.canReactivate: Reactivate the tenant to restore access.
suspendedBanner.askOperator: A product owner or admin can reactivate it.

suspendedData.title: Not available while the tenant is suspended
suspendedData.body: Members and invitations of a suspended tenant cannot be viewed or changed. A product owner or admin can reactivate the tenant.
suspendedData.bodyCanReactivate: Members and invitations of a suspended tenant cannot be viewed or changed. Reactivate the tenant to manage them again.
